40022447.author: पदार्थः
40022447.content: तस्य his, तद्वचनं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, अवाक्छिरास्तथाभूत्वा having become thus with head bowed down, वाक्यमेतदुवाच spoke this statement, ह indeed.

40022447.author: Translation
40022447.content: Having heard those words of Rama, whose deeds are unblemished, the ascetic, with his head still bowed, then spoke the following words.

40022448.author: पदार्थः
40022448.content: शूद्रयोन्यां in a Shudra womb, प्रसूतो born, ऽस्मि I am, शम्बूको Shambuka, नाम named, नामतः by name, देवत्वं divinity, पार्थये I seek, राम O Rama, सशरीरो with my body, महायशः O greatly renowned one.

40022448.author: Translation
40022448.content: The ascetic declared that he was born in a Shudra family, named Shambuka, and that he sought to attain divinity with his physical body, O greatly renowned Rama.

40022449.author: पदार्थः
40022449.content: न not, मिथ्या falsely, ऽहं I, वदे speak, राम O Rama, देवलोकजिगीषया with the desire to conquer the world of gods, शूद्रं a Shudra, मां me, विद्धि know, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तप penance, उग्रं severe, समास्थितम् engaged in.

40022449.author: Translation
40022449.content: Shambuka affirmed to Rama that he was not speaking falsely out of a desire to conquer the world of gods, and asked Rama to know him as a Shudra engaged in severe penance.

40022450.author: पदार्थः
40022450.content: भाषतः while speaking, तस्य of that, शूद्रस्य of the Shudra, खड्गं sword, सुरुचिरप्रभम् of very beautiful luster, निष्कृष्य having drawn out, कोशात् from the sheath, विमलम् spotless, शिरः head, चिच्छेद cut off, राघवः Rama.

40022450.author: Translation
40022450.content: Rama, having drawn his spotless sword of very beautiful luster from its sheath, cut off the head of that Shudra while he was speaking.

40022451.author: पदार्थः
40022451.content: तस्मिन् that, शूद्रे Shudra, हते having been killed, देवाः gods, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader, साधु साधु इति "Excellent! Excellent!" thus, काकुत्स्थं Rama, प्रशशंसुः praised, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again.

40022451.author: Translation
40022451.content: When that Shudra was killed, the gods, led by Indra and Agni, repeatedly praised Rama, exclaiming "Excellent! Excellent!"

40022452.author: पदार्थः
40022452.content: पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, महती great, आसीत् was, दिव्यानाम् divine, सुसुगन्धिनाम् very fragrant, पुष्पाणाम् of flowers, वायुमुक्तानाम् released by the wind, सर्वतः from all sides, प्रपपात ह fell down indeed.

40022452.author: Translation
40022452.content: A great shower of divine, very fragrant flowers, released by the wind, fell down from all sides.

40022453.author: पदार्थः
40022453.content: सुप्रीताः very pleased, च and, अब्रुवन् said, रामं to Rama, देवाः gods, सत्यपराक्रमम् of true valor, सुरकार्यम् work of the gods, इदम् this, सौम्य O gentle one, सुकृतम् well done, ते by you, महामते O great-minded one.

40022453.author: Translation
40022453.content: The very pleased gods then said to Rama, the one of true valor, "O gentle and great-minded one, this task for the gods has been well accomplished by you."

40022454.author: पदार्थः
40022454.content: गृहाण accept, च and, वरम् boon, सौम्य O gentle one, यत् which, त्वम् you, इच्छसि desire, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, स्वर्गभाक् partaker of heaven, न not, हि indeed, शूद्रः Shudra, अयम् this, त्वत्कृते because of you, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022454.author: Translation
40022454.content: "O gentle one, subduer of enemies, and delight of the Raghus, accept any boon you desire, for this Shudra will certainly not attain heaven because of your action."

40022455.author: पदार्थः
40022455.content: देवानां of the gods, भाषितं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवः Rama, सुसमाहितः very attentive, उवाच spoke, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यं words, सहस्राक्षं to the thousand-eyed one, पुरन्दरम् to the destroyer of cities.

40022455.author: Translation
40022455.content: Having heard the words of the gods, Rama, composed and with folded hands, spoke to Indra, the thousand-eyed destroyer of cities.

40022456.author: पदार्थः
40022456.content: यदि if, देवाः gods, प्रसन्नाः pleased, मे with me, द्विजपुत्रः the son of the brahmin, सः he, जीवतु may live, दिशन्तु may they grant, वरम् boon, एतम् this, मे to me, इप्सितं desired, परमं supreme, मम my.

40022456.author: Translation
40022456.content: Rama requested that if the gods were pleased with him, they should grant his greatest desire: that the brahmin's son be brought back to life.

40022457.author: पदार्थः
40022457.content: मम my, अपचारात् due to fault, यातः gone, असौ that, ब्राह्मणस्य of the brahmin, एकपुत्रकः only son, अप्राप्तकालः whose time had not come, कालेन by time, नीतः taken, वैवस्वतक्षयम् to the abode of Yama.

40022457.author: Translation
40022457.content: Rama declared that the brahmin's only son, whose time had not yet come, was taken to Yama's abode due to Rama's own transgression.

40022458.author: पदार्थः
40022458.content: तं him, जीवयथ you revive, भद्रं welfare, वः to you, न not, अनृतं untruth, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ you ought, द्विजस्य to the brahmin, संश्रुतः promised, अर्थः word, मे by me, जीवयिष्यामि I shall revive, ते your, सुतम् son.

40022458.author: Translation
40022458.content: Rama urged the gods to revive the child, wishing them well, and reminded them that he had promised the brahmin to bring his son back to life, thus he could not allow his word to be false.

40022459.author: पदार्थः
40022459.content: राघवस्य of Rama, तु indeed, तत् that, वाक्यं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, विबुधसत्तमाः the best among the gods, प्रत्युचू replied, राघवम् to Rama, प्रीताः pleased, देवाः gods, प्रीतिसमन्वितम् filled with affection.

40022459.author: Translation
40022459.content: Having heard Rama's words, the best among the gods, pleased and filled with affection, replied to Rama.

40022460.author: पदार्थः
40022460.content: निर्वृतो be relieved, भव be, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, सः that, अस्मिन् in this, अहनि day, बालकः boy, जीवितं life, प्राप्तवान् obtained, भूयः again, समेतः united, च and, अपि also, बन्धुभिः with relatives

40022460.author: Translation
40022460.content: O Kakutstha, be relieved, for that boy has regained his life and is reunited with his relatives this very day.

40022461.author: पदार्थः
40022461.content: यस्मिन् in which, मुहूर्ते moment, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, शूद्रः Shudra, अयं this, विनिपातितः was killed, तस्मिन् in that, मुहूर्ते moment, बालः boy, असौ that, जीवेन with life, समयुज्यत was united

40022461.author: Translation
40022461.content: O Kakutstha, the very moment this Shudra was struck down, that boy was reunited with his life.

40022462.author: पदार्थः
40022462.content: स्वस्ति well-being, प्राप्नुहि obtain, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, साधु well, याम let us go, नरर्षभ O best among men, अगस्त्यस्य of Agastya, आश्रमपदं hermitage, द्रष्टुं to see, इच्छाम we wish, राघव O Raghava

40022462.author: Translation
40022462.content: May you obtain well-being, O best among men, and may good fortune be yours; we wish to go and see the hermitage of Agastya, O Raghava.

40022463.author: पदार्थः
40022463.content: तस्य his, सुमहाद्युतेः of great splendour, ब्रह्मर्षेः of the brahmin-sage, दीक्षा the consecratory vow, समाप्ता हि is indeed completed, जलशय्यां on a bed of water, समासतः as he abode, द्वादशं वर्षम् the twelfth year, गतं हि has now passed.

40022463.author: Translation
40022463.content: The consecratory vow of that brahmin-sage of great splendour is now completed, for the twelfth year has passed as he lay abiding upon a bed of water.

40022464.author: पदार्थः
40022464.content: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, तत् therefore, गमिष्यामः we shall go, मुनिं the sage, समभिनन्दितुम् to greet, त्वं you, च and, अपि also, आगच्छ come, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, द्रष्टुं to see, तं that, ऋषिसत्तमम् best of sages

40022464.author: Translation
40022464.content: O Kakutstha, we shall therefore go to greet that sage, and you too should come, for your welfare, to see that best of sages.

40022465.author: पदार्थः
40022465.content: सः he, तथा so, इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाय having promised, देवानां of the gods, रघुनन्दनः Rama, आरुरोह ascended, विमानं aerial chariot, तं that, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold

40022465.author: Translation
40022465.content: Having thus agreed to the words of the gods, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, ascended that Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was adorned with gold.

40022466.author: पदार्थः
40022466.content: ततः then, देवाः the gods, प्रयाताः departed, ते they, विमानैः by aerial chariots, बहुविस्तरैः very extensive, रामः Rama, अपि also, अनुजगाम followed, आशु quickly, कुम्भयोनेः of Agastya, तपोवनम् to the hermitage.

40022466.author: Translation
40022466.content: Then, the gods departed in their vast aerial chariots, and Rama also quickly followed them to the hermitage of Agastya.

40022467.author: पदार्थः
40022467.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, देवान् the gods, सम्प्राप्तान् who had arrived, अगस्त्यः Agastya, तपसाम् of austerities, निधिः a treasure, अर्चयामास worshipped, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, सर्वान् all, तान् them, अविशेषतः without distinction.

40022467.author: Translation
40022467.content: Upon seeing the arrived gods, the righteous Agastya, a treasure-house of austerities, worshipped all of them equally without distinction.

40022468.author: पदार्थः
40022468.content: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, पूजां the worship, सम्पूज्य and having honored, च and, महामुनिम् the great sage, जग्मुः went, ते they, त्रिदशाः the gods, हृष्टाः delighted, नाकपृष्ठम् to heaven, सहानुगैः with their followers.

40022468.author: Translation
40022468.content: Having accepted the worship and honored the great sage, the delighted gods then departed to heaven with their followers.

40022469.author: पदार्थः
40022469.content: गतेषु when they had gone, तेषु those (gods), काकुत्स्थः Rama, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka (chariot), अवरुह्य having descended, च and, ततः then, अभिवादयामास bowed down to, हि indeed, अगस्त्यम् Agastya, ऋषिसत्तमम् the best of sages.

40022469.author: Translation
40022469.content: After the gods had departed, Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, descended from the Pushpaka chariot and then saluted Agastya, the foremost of sages.

40022470.author: पदार्थः
40022470.content: सः he (Rama), अभिवाद्य having saluted, महात्मानम् the great-souled one (Agastya), ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with brilliance, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, परमम् excellent, प्राप्य having received, निषसाद sat down, नराधिपः the king of men (Rama).

40022470.author: Translation
40022470.content: Having saluted the great-souled Agastya, who shone as if with brilliance, and having received excellent hospitality, the king of men, Rama, then sat down.

40022471.author: पदार्थः
40022471.content: तम् him, उवाच said, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, कुम्भयोनिः Agastya, महातपाः the great ascetic, स्वागतम् welcome, ते to you, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तो ऽसि you have arrived, राघव O scion of Raghu

40022471.author: Translation
40022471.content: The greatly effulgent and great ascetic Agastya said to him, "Welcome to you, O best among men, O scion of Raghu, fortunately you have arrived."

40022472.author: पदार्थः
40022472.content: त्वम् you, मे by me, बहुमतः highly esteemed, राम O Rama, गुणैः by qualities, बहुभिः many, उत्तमैः excellent, अतिथिः a guest, पूजनीयश्च and worthy of worship, मम my, नित्यम् always, हृदि in the heart, स्थितः residing

40022472.author: Translation
40022472.content: O Rama, you are highly esteemed by me for your many excellent qualities, and you are a guest worthy of worship, always residing in my heart.

40022473.author: पदार्थः
40022473.content: सुराः the gods, हि indeed, कथयन्ति speak, त्वाम् of you, आगतम् having come, शूद्रघातिनम् as the slayer of a Shudra, ब्राह्मणस्य of a Brahmin, तु but, धर्मेण by righteousness, त्वया by you, जीवापितः made alive, सुतः the son

40022473.author: Translation
40022473.content: Indeed, the gods speak of you as having come after slaying the Shudra (Shambuka), and by your righteous action, the Brahmin's son was brought back to life.

40022474.author: पदार्थः
40022474.content: उष्यताम् let it be stayed, च and, इह here, रजनी the night, सकाशे near, मम my, राघव O scion of Raghu, प्रभाते in the morning, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka, त्वम् you, गन्ता ऽसि will go, पुरम् to the city, एव indeed, हि certainly

40022474.author: Translation
40022474.content: O scion of Raghu, please stay here for the night near me, and in the morning, you will certainly go to your city by the Pushpaka chariot.

40022475.author: पदार्थः
40022475.content: त्वम् you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् the glorious one, त्वयि in you, सर्वम् everything, प्रतिष्ठितम् is established, त्वम् you, प्रभुः the lord, सर्वदेवानाम् of all gods, पुरुषः the being, त्वम् you, सनातनः the eternal

40022475.author: Translation
40022475.content: Indeed, you are the glorious Narayana, in whom everything is established; you are the lord of all gods, and you are the eternal being.

40022476.author: पदार्थः
40022476.content: इदं this, च and, आभरणं ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, निर्मितं created, विश्वकर्मणा by Vishwakarma, दिव्यं divine, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा form/body, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with its own splendor, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व accept, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, मत्प्रियं my pleasure, कुरु do, राघव O Raghava.

40022476.author: Translation
40022476.content: O gentle Raghava, please accept this divine ornament, created by Vishwakarma, which shines with its own splendor and divine form, and by doing so, fulfill my wish.

40022477.author: पदार्थः
40022477.content: दत्तस्य of what is given, हि indeed, पुनर्दाने in giving again, सुमहत्फलम् a very great reward, उच्यते is said, भरणे in supporting, हि indeed, भवान् you, शक्तः are capable, सेन्द्राणां along with Indra, मरुतामपि even of the Maruts.

40022477.author: Translation
40022477.content: It is said that giving something again, once it has been given, yields a very great reward, and indeed, you are capable of sustaining even Indra and the Maruts.

40022478.author: पदार्थः
40022478.content: त्वं you, हि indeed, शक्तः are capable, तारयितुं to save/protect, सेन्द्रानपि even Indra and others, दिवौकसः the dwellers of heaven, तस्मात् therefore, प्रदास्ये I will give, विधिवत् properly, तत् that, प्रतीच्छ accept, नराधिप O king of men.

40022478.author: Translation
40022478.content: Indeed, you are capable of protecting even the gods, including Indra, therefore I will properly give this to you; O king of men, please accept it.

40022479.author: पदार्थः
40022479.content: दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, चित्रं wonderful, प्रदीप्तमिव shining like, भास्करम् the sun.

40022479.author: Translation
40022479.content: This divine and wonderful ornament shines brilliantly like the sun.

40022480.author: पदार्थः
40022480.content: अथ then, उवाच spoke, महात्मानम् to the great-souled one, इक्ष्वाकूणां of the Ikshvakus, महारथः the great warrior, रामो Rama, मतिमतां of the intelligent ones, श्रेष्ठः the best, क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् remembering the duty of a Kshatriya.

40022480.author: Translation
40022480.content: Then, Rama, the great warrior of the Ikshvakus and the best among the intelligent, spoke to the great-souled one, remembering the duties of a Kshatriya.

40022481.author: पदार्थः
40022481.content: प्रतिग्रहः acceptance of gifts, अयम् this, भगवन् O revered one, ब्राह्मणस्य for a Brahmana, अविगर्हितः blameless, गृह्णीयाम् should I accept, क्षत्रियः a Kshatriya, अहम् I, वै indeed, कथम् how, ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव O best among Brahmanas.

40022481.author: Translation
40022481.content: Rama questions the sage, asking how he, a Kshatriya, can accept a gift that is considered blameless only for a Brahmana.

40022482.author: पदार्थः
40022482.content: ब्राह्मणेन by a Brahmana, विशेषेण especially, दत्तम् given, तत् that, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, तु but, रामेण by Rama, प्रत्युवाच replied, महानृषिः the great sage.

40022482.author: Translation
40022482.content: Rama further requested the sage to explain the reason for accepting such a gift, especially when given by a Brahmana, to which the great sage then replied.

40022483.author: पदार्थः
40022483.content: आसन् were, कृतयुगे in the Krita Yuga, राम O Rama, ब्रह्मभूते when Brahma was present, पुरायुगे in the ancient age, अपार्थिवाः without a king, प्रजाः the people, सर्वाः all, सुराणाम् of the gods, तु but, शतक्रतुः Indra.

40022483.author: Translation
40022483.content: The great sage began by telling Rama that in the ancient Krita Yuga, when the world was pure, all people were without an earthly king, though Indra was the ruler of the gods.

40022484.author: पदार्थः
40022484.content: ताः those, प्रजाः people, देवदेवेशम् to the Lord of gods, राजार्थम् for the sake of a king, समुपाद्रवन् approached, सुराणाम् of the gods, स्थापितः established, राजा king, त्वया by you, देव O god, शतक्रतुः Indra.

40022484.author: Translation
40022484.content: Those people approached the Lord of gods (Brahma) requesting a king, reminding him that he had already established Indra as the king of the gods.

40022485.author: पदार्थः
40022485.content: प्रयच्छ give, नः to us, हि indeed, लोकेश O Lord of the worlds, पार्थिवम् an earthly ruler, नरपुङ्गवम् a best among men, यस्मै to whom, पूजां worship, प्रयुञ्जानाः offering, धूतपापाः having cleansed sins, चरेमहि we may live, न not, वसामः we live, विना without, राज्ञा a king, एषः this, नः our, निश्चयः firm resolve, परः supreme.

40022485.author: Translation
40022485.content: The people implored Brahma, the Lord of the worlds, to grant them an earthly king, a best among men, whom they could worship to cleanse their sins and under whose rule they could live, as they declared their supreme resolve not to live without a king.

40022486.author: पदार्थः
40022486.content: प्रजानाम् of the subjects, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, निश्चयित्वा having ascertained, अर्थम् the purpose, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022486.author: Translation
40022486.content: Having heard the words of the subjects, and having ascertained their excellent purpose.

40022487.author: पदार्थः
40022487.content: ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरश्रेष्ठः best among gods, लोकपालान् the protectors of the worlds, सवासवान् along with Vasava (Indra), समाहूय having summoned, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, तेजोभागान् shares of your splendor, प्रयच्छत give.

40022487.author: Translation
40022487.content: Then, Brahma, the best among gods, summoned all the protectors of the worlds, including Indra, and told them to bestow shares of their splendor.

40022488.author: पदार्थः
40022488.content: ततः then, ददुः gave, लोकपालाः the protectors of the worlds, सर्वे all, भागान् shares, स्वतेजसः of their own splendor, अक्षुपत् च and sneezed, ततः then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, यतः from which, जातः was born, क्षुपः Kṣupa, नृपः the king.

40022488.author: Translation
40022488.content: Then all the protectors of the worlds gave shares of their own splendor, and then Brahma sneezed, from which King Kṣupa was born.

40022489.author: पदार्थः
40022489.content: तम् him, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपालानाम् of the protectors of the worlds, सहांशैः with their shares (of splendor), समयोजयत् endowed, ततः then, ददौ gave, नृपम् the king, तासाम् of those, प्रजानाम् subjects, ईश्वरम् the ruler, क्षुपम् Kṣupa.

40022489.author: Translation
40022489.content: Brahma then endowed him (Kṣupa) with the shares of splendor from the protectors of the worlds, and then gave King Kṣupa as the ruler of those subjects.

40022490.author: पदार्थः
40022490.content: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण with the share of Indra, च and, भागेन with the share, महीम् the earth, आज्ञापयन् rules, नृपः the king, वारुणेन with the share of Varuna, तु but, भागेन with the share, वपुः the body, पुष्यति nourishes, पार्थिवः the king.

40022490.author: Translation
40022490.content: There, the king rules the earth with the share of Indra, and with the share of Varuna, the king nourishes his body.

40022491.author: पदार्थः
40022491.content: कौबेरेण by the northern (Kubera's), तु indeed, भागेन part, वित्तम् wealth, आसाम् to them, ददौ he gave, तदा then, यः which, तु but, याम्यः southern (Yama's), अभवत् was, भागः part, तेन by that, शास्ति स्म he ruled, सः he, प्रजाः the subjects.

40022491.author: Translation
40022491.content: Then, he gave wealth to the people from the northern part (Kubera's domain), and with the southern part (Yama's domain), he ruled his subjects.

40022492.author: पदार्थः
40022492.content: तत्र there, ऐन्द्रेण by the eastern (Indra's), नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, भागेन part, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, तारणार्थं for the purpose of saving, मम me, प्रभो O lord.

40022492.author: Translation
40022492.content: O best among men, O delight of the Raghus, O lord, please accept this eastern part (Indra's domain) for my salvation; may good fortune be yours.

40022493.author: पदार्थः
40022493.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषेः of the sage, परमधार्मिकम् most righteous, तत् that, रामः Rama, प्रतिजग्राह accepted, मुनेः of the sage, आभरणं ornament, वरम् excellent.

40022493.author: Translation
40022493.content: Having heard that most righteous speech of the sage, Rama accepted that excellent ornament from the sage.

40022494.author: पदार्थः
40022494.content: प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, ततः then, रामः Rama, तत् that, आभरणम् ornament, उत्तमम् excellent, आगमं origin, तस्य of that, दीप्तस्य shining, प्रष्टुम् to ask, एव indeed, उपचक्रमे began.

40022494.author: Translation
40022494.content: Having accepted that excellent ornament, Rama then began to inquire about the origin of that radiant object.

40022495.author: पदार्थः
40022495.content: अति extremely, अद्भुतम् wonderful, इदं this, दिव्यं divine, वपुषा with a form, युक्तम् endowed, उत्तमम् excellent, कथं how, वा or, भगवता by your revered self, प्राप्तं obtained, कुतः from where, वा or, केन by whom, वा or, हृतम् taken away.

40022495.author: Translation
40022495.content: Rama asked, "How was this extremely wonderful, divine, and excellent form obtained by your revered self, or from where, or by whom was it taken away?"

40022496.author: पदार्थः
40022496.content: कुतूहलितया out of curiosity, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पृच्छामि I ask, त्वां you, महायशः O greatly renowned one, आश्चर्याणां of wonders, बहूनां many, हि indeed, निधिः a treasure, परमको supreme, भवान् you are

40022496.author: Translation
40022496.content: O greatly renowned Brahmana, I ask you out of curiosity, for you are indeed a supreme treasure of many wonders.

40022497.author: पदार्थः
40022497.content: एवं thus, ब्रुवति when speaking, काकुत्स्थे Kakutstha (Rama), मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, शृणु listen, राम O Rama, यथावृत्तं as it happened, पुरा formerly, त्रेतायुगे in the Treta Yuga, युगे in the age

40022497.author: Translation
40022497.content: When Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, spoke thus, the sage then replied, "Listen, O Rama, to what happened formerly in the Treta Yuga."

40022498.author: पदार्थः
40022498.content: रमणीयप्रदेशे in this beautiful region, अस्मिन् in this, वने forest, यत् which, दृष्टवान् saw, अहम् I, आश्चर्यं a wonder, मे to me, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, दानम् charity, आश्रित्य concerning, केवलम् merely

40022498.author: Translation
40022498.content: O mighty-armed one, I saw a wonder in this beautiful forest region, which was solely concerning the power of charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 76 ।। Thus ends the seventy-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
